applicant_utility.summary: This scheme sends Sri Lankan undergraduates, postgraduates and doctoral candidates to top-ranked Pakistani universities in Engineering Science, Basic and Natural Sciences, or Social Sciences, and it is worth preparing for only if your intended degree sits inside those three discipline groups. One thing to plan around: HEC describes the programme as 1,000 places over five years, of which 800 are fully funded and 200 are only partially funded, so a successful application does not guarantee the complete package. Because the last round closed in July 2026 and HEC announces the window on its own portal, the practical move is to have your university admission documents ready before the next notice appears rather than waiting for it. Women applicants are explicitly encouraged, so do not treat that as a reason to self-select out.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Sri Lankan nationals who want a degree in engineering, basic or natural sciences, or social sciences at a Pakistani university and can move when the annual window opens.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your intended degree falls in Engineering Science, Basic and Natural Sciences, or Social Sciences before doing anything else
Shortlist top-ranked Pakistani universities in your discipline and check each one's own admission requirements, since meeting them is part of eligibility
Prepare academic transcripts, degree certificates and your passport in advance, because the window historically closes within weeks of opening
Check the HEC Pak-Sri Lanka programme pages and the info.paksl@hec.gov.pk desk address for the next round's announcement
If you are a woman applicant, note that HEC explicitly encourages applications from women
common_rejection_risks: Choosing a discipline outside the three eligible groups, which disqualifies the application regardless of grades
Failing to meet the admission requirements of the chosen Pakistani university, which is a separate hurdle from the scholarship
Missing the online window entirely, since the previous round closed in July 2026 after an extension and offers are tied to that window
Assuming a fully funded package when 200 of the 1,000 places are described as partially funded
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: HEC publishes no monetary value for the allowances, so the size of the accommodation, study and books allowances cannot be checked against living costs in Pakistan. Applicants should budget for personal spending, visa and documentation costs, and any travel beyond the single one-time return air ticket.
document_audit: Academic documents must satisfy both HEC and the specific Pakistani university, so mismatched transcripts or missing degree certificates stall the application at the admission stage
The page read did not publish a document list, so confirm the required uploads with the programme desk at info.paksl@hec.gov.pk before the window opens
alerts: The scheme runs as an annual round with a short window; the previous round closed on 5 July 2026 after an extension
Only 800 of the 1,000 places are described as fully funded, so ask which stream your offer falls into before accepting

applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Watch for HEC's advertised cycle, apply online through the HEC portal within the window, and route queries to the programme desk at info.paksl@hec.gov.pk while the application is assessed.
